role: finite-window development screen of the same two announced-task controllers
registration_context: all 22 components and four April start-zero pilots observed safe with 95/95 requests fulfilled; other announced windows unobserved

workload.data: reuse original cached 2024 per-unit acceptances through cached_unit; no API or new data. Prefix comes from the existing one-day prefix for each sample
workload.receipt_marks: for each original 168-hour source window use receipt_marks at its 168 hourly clocks; its latest nonzero endpoint in (clock-60,clock] and frozen priority determine each mark
workload.coordinates: generate marks in sample-relative minutes; translate release and each source timestamp to window-relative minutes by subtracting its source-window start; retain sample dates and original source coordinates in workload metadata
workload.announcements: announce each mark for release+120, keep all active/inactive marks binding; predefined inactive startup slots at 0 and 60; use announce_requests and delivery_clock_roster with the retained contract
workload.requests: each workload has its own original active count, not a forced count of 95; all its active requests remain the denominator; inactive slots create no delivered requests
workload.reset: each simulated window resets SOC to [49,49] and both initial PN rows to zero; no cross-window warm start
workload.boundary: last requests may execute 120 minutes after the source sample ends, using only already released instructions; no public data after the ten-day source sample is needed

controller.implementation: unchanged nominate_announced in problems/public_battery_announced_nomination.py and simulate_service in problems/public_battery_causal_service.py
controller.fixed_parameters: unchanged 98 MW shared gross power, two 98 MWh stocks, 0.92 efficiencies, targets, 30-minute PN clock, 60-minute PN lead, 120-minute announcements, 1/30/1 pulses and 1e-8 physical tolerances
controller.information: controller receives only released announcements, own actual stocks, PN and own admitted pulse/past execution; full marks stay dispatcher-only
controller.infeasibility: unchanged zero fallback, planning and known-reference failure records; no retuning or policy selection during execution

roster.reuse: reuse only the four completed April window-start-zero pilots after its regenerated announced workload matches the retained 168 announcements and 170 delivery clocks; no rollout or nomination recomputation for reused rows; retain explicit artifact provenance
roster.order: sample in original April/July/October order, window start ascending, profile in retained order, dispatch rule in retained order
roster.coverage: evaluate every registered cell even after a scientific failure; stop only for an implementation/interface/accounting discrepancy and preserve completed cells

accounting.window_success: all 10200 minutes physical, all workload requests fulfilled, no known unsafe commitment
accounting.interruption: preserve last safe state, first physical/dispatch failure, executed-prefix errors, observed failures and unobserved obligation count
accounting.call_counts: new and reused windows, declarations, half/whole-hour nominations, scalar stock projections, reference-safety and minute-physics calls counted separately; any tests or repairs/replays separate
accounting.budgets: at most 300 scalar projections and 51 safety trajectories per half-hour decision; whole-hour nomination zero without extra trajectories
accounting.output: compact per-window summary and per-sample/profile/rule success counts; keep first failure state and preceding two relevant nomination records for every failed window; no minute trajectories or monetary outcomes
accounting.tests: window-relative receipt/source translation and exact April-pilot workload reuse; do not rerun unchanged policy regressions or components without a new implementation change

gate.pass: the same retained profile must safely fulfill all requests in at least 70/73 windows in each of April, July and October under each dispatch rule
gate.interpretation: finite overlapping-window development criterion, not a statistical 95-percent reliability bound or independent confirmation; record any unsafe profile/window without requiring or manufacturing one
gate.if_pass: register the next announced-task library/objective stage; safe/unsafe candidate support and source comparison design remain to be established before any source comparison
gate.if_fail: retain all failures and diagnose the earliest failed physical/planning/request mechanism from saved records before changing the task or controller

preservation: retain all unannounced tasks, negatives, original pilots and protocols; this stage changes only population coverage, not task assumptions or policy parameters
limitations: announced analyst simulation developed after prior failures, fixed reset stocks and overlapping 2024 windows; two retained constant profiles do not establish functional library diversity, economic outcomes, historical BM validity, source benefit, independent confirmation or OR submission readiness
